verdict.rationale: Folk's own pricing page lists "Email campaigns" on the base tier and "Email sequences" on a higher tier, which points to first-party in-CRM outbound email and multi-step sequences. These are bare feature-list mentions with no documentation of how it works, so the depth of the capability is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of email templates and personalization, sequence step and scheduling configuration, sending from inside the CRM UI, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
